title: The Trust Entrusted to the River
intro: A soul faced an impossible decree, where the life of a newborn hung in the balance. Guided by divine inspiration, a desperate command was obeyed, and a precious secret was set adrift on the current, only to be returned in a way unforeseen.
clues: I lived under the shadow of a tyrant who commanded the killing of newborn males.
A divine inspiration came to me, instructing me to take a desperate and heart-wrenching action.
I placed my precious infant in a chest and set it upon the flowing river.
My heart became empty, and I almost revealed the secret, but Allah strengthened my resolve.
I sent someone to follow the child's journey downstream as the current carried the chest away.
The child was found by the household of the tyrant, and eventually, I was reunited with my child and became the nursemaid.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Mother of Prophet Musa
Asiya (Wife of Pharaoh)
Maryam (Mother of Prophet Isa)
The wife of Prophet Lut
The mother of Prophet Yahya (wife of Zakariya)

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: She placed her child in a chest and set it on the river
She hid her child in a cave
She abandoned her child in the desert
She threw her child into a fire
She left her child at the door of a mosque
trial.answer: She placed her child in a chest and set it on the river

location.label: Key Element
options: A chest set afloat on the river
A burning bush
A staff that turned into a snake
A table spread with food from heaven
A she-camel sent as a sign
location.answer: A chest set afloat on the river

outcome.label: Outcome
options: She was reunited with her child and nursed him
She never saw her child again
She was executed by the tyrant
She became a queen in Egypt
She migrated to another land and lived in exile
outcome.answer: She was reunited with her child and nursed him

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
